decisions.reason: The secure document vault builds directly on the firm's digital identity and security base, so it is easy to integrate, interpret early customer demand for, and improve within the existing platform.
An identity-bound payment wallet is highly related to the firm's IAM, payment, and compliance capabilities, giving strong absorptive capacity and clear strategic fit with regulated German clients.
Although NFC-tag login is somewhat more niche, it still extends the firm's core authentication know-how and can be refined through learning from existing security customers.
A secure payment and wallet framework sits at the center of the firm's integrated super-app architecture and benefits from deep prior knowledge in payments, security, and ecosystem building.
The secure platform for building multi-service mobile apps is essentially the firm's core strategic direction, so management would continue backing it as a foundational product.

The application shielding library leverages the firm's long-standing application-security expertise and can strengthen the wider product stack, making continued development commercially and technically sensible.
